# 4XVR Breaker

[![Build](https://github.com/ghitori/4xvr-breaker/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ghitori/4xvr-breaker/actions/workflows/build.yml)

> A module to crack the 4XVR Premium Version.

LSPosed module (libxposed API 102) that hooks
`cn.vr4p.oculus4xvrplayerov.Main4XActivity.IsMP()` in **4XVR Video Player**
(`cn.vr4p.oculus4xvrplayerov`, v1.10.26) and forces it to return `true`
after the original call, unlocking the premium features of the player.

## Features

- Hooks `Main4XActivity.IsMP()` (`hookPoint: after`) and overrides the result to `true`
- Method lookup by name — signature-agnostic, prefers a no-arg boolean method
- `PROTECTIVE` exception mode — hook errors never crash the target app
- Zero UI: runs entirely inside the target process via LSPosed
- Scoped to the 4XVR package by default (`staticScope=true`)

## Requirements

- Android 8.0+ with **LSPosed v1.9.0+** (or LSPatch)
- Framework Xposed API ≥ 101 (module targets API 102)

## Build

Requires **JDK 17+** only. Build tools and dependencies are downloaded
automatically on the first run.

```bash
./build.sh
```

Output: `out/4XVR-Breaker-v1.0.apk`

## Install

```bash
adb install -r out/4XVR-Breaker-v1.0.apk
```

1. Enable the module in LSPosed Manager (scope is preset to the 4XVR package)
2. Restart 4XVR, or reboot the device
3. Verify in LSPosed logs: `hooked: ... IsMP()`

## Project structure

```
.
├── app/src/main/
│   ├── AndroidManifest.xml                  # module name / description (android:label)
│   ├── java/org/ghitori/fourxvrbreaker/MainHook.java   # module entry (XposedModule)
│   ├── res/                                 # strings + rounded launcher icon (mipmap-*)
│   └── resources/META-INF/xposed/           # java_init.list / module.prop / scope.list
├── build.sh                                 # one-shot build script (self-bootstrapping)
└── README.md
```

## Disclaimer

For learning and research purposes only. Use at your own risk.

# 4XVR 断路器

[![构建](https://github.com/ghitori/4xvr-breaker/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ghitori/4xvr-breaker/actions/workflows/build.yml)

> 破解4XVR高级版的模块。

挂钩的 LSPod 模块（libxposed API 102）
**4XVR 视频播放器**中的`cn.vr4p.oculus4xvrplayerov.Main4XActivity.IsMP()`
（`cn.vr4p.oculus4xvrplayerov`，v1.10.26）并强制它返回`true`
在原始通话后，解锁播放器的高级功能。

## 特点

- 挂钩“Main4XActivity.IsMP()”（“hookPoint: after”）并将结果覆盖为“true”
- 按名称查找方法 — 与签名无关，更喜欢无参数布尔方法
-“保护”异常模式 - 挂钩错误永远不会使目标应用程序崩溃
- 零 UI：通过 LSPod 完全在目标进程内运行
- 默认情况下作用域为 4XVR 包 (`staticScope=true`)

## 要求

- Android 8.0+，带有 **LSPosed v1.9.0+**（或 LSPatch）
- 框架 Xposed API ≥ 101（模块目标 API 102）

## 构建

仅需要 **JDK 17+**。下载构建工具和依赖项
第一次运行时自动。

````bash
./build.sh
````

输出：`out/4XVR-Breaker-v1.0.apk`

## 安装

````bash
adb install -r out/4XVR-Breaker-v1.0.apk
````

1.在LSPod Manager中启用该模块（范围预设为4XVR包）
2.重启4XVR，或者重启设备
3. 在 LSPod 日志中验证：`hooked: ... IsMP()`

## 项目结构

````
。
├── 应用程序/src/main/
│ ├── AndroidManifest.xml # 模块名称/描述(android:label)
│ ├── java/org/ghitori/fourxvrbreaker/MainHook.java # 模块入口(XposedModule)
│ ├── res/ # 字符串 + 圆形启动器图标 (mipmap-*)
│ └── resources/META-INF/xposed/ # java_init.list / module.prop /scope.list
├── build.sh # 一次性构建脚本（自引导）
└── 自述文件.md
````

仅供学习和研究之用。使用风险自负。
